Container.Name: DockMon
Container.Overview:
DockMon is a comprehensive, self-hosted Docker container monitoring and management platform. Monitor local and remote containers in real time with customizable dashboard widgets, intelligent auto-restart logic, multi-channel alerting (Discord, Slack, Telegram, Pushover, Gotify, SMTP), multi-container live log viewing, Compose stack management, and automatic container image updates.
[b]Key Features:[/b] - [b]Multi-Host Monitoring:[/b] Monitor containers across unlimited local and remote Docker hosts with a lightweight Go agent. - [b]Real-Time Dashboard & Stats:[/b] Drag-and-drop customizable widgets with WebSocket-streamed CPU, memory, and network metrics. - [b]Intelligent Auto-Restart:[/b] Per-container auto-restart policy with exponential backoff and retry tracking. - [b]Multi-Channel Alerting:[/b] Real-time alerts to Discord, Slack, Telegram, Pushover, Gotify, or Email with customizable alert rules and blackout windows. - [b]Stack Management:[/b] Create, edit, and deploy Docker Compose stacks with image pull progress. - [b]Automatic Updates:[/b] Schedule automatic image updates or trigger one-click updates with webhooks. - [b]Multi-User & SSO/OIDC:[/b] Group-based RBAC with custom groups, granular permissions, and OIDC single sign-on (Authentik, Keycloak, Okta, Authelia).
[b]Initial Setup:[/b] 1. Open the WebUI at [inline]https://[IP]:[PORT:443]/[/inline] after starting the container (accept the self-signed SSL certificate). 2. Create your administrator account on the initial setup screen. Local Docker socket access is pre-configured.
[b]Credits & Support:[/b] - DockMon is created by [b]darthnorse[/b] ([url=https://github.com/darthnorse/dockmon]GitHub[/url]). Support the developer at [url=https://buymeacoffee.com/darthnorse]Buy Me a Coffee[/url]. - The donation link below specifically supports the maintenance of this Unraid template repository.

Config.Name: WebUI Port (HTTPS)
Config.Description: The WebUI port for DockMon (internal port is 443 HTTPS).

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Storage path for DockMon database, settings, SSL certificates, and stack configurations.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Host Docker socket required for managing and monitoring local containers.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for the container (e.g. Europe/Amsterdam, America/New_York, UTC).

Config.Name: External URL
Config.Description: Optional public URL (e.g. https://dockmon.yourdomain.com) included in alerts for one-click action buttons.

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: Allowed CORS origins if accessing DockMon behind a reverse proxy (e.g. https://dockmon.yourdomain.com).

Config.Name: Base Path
Config.Description: Subpath if running behind a reverse proxy subfolder (e.g. /dockmon/).

Config.Name: Force Local Login
Config.Description: Emergency recovery flag: set to 'true' to force local login if SSO/OIDC misconfiguration locks you out.

Config.Name: Host /proc (System Metrics)
Config.Description: Read-only mount of host /proc for accurate local CPU, memory, and IP detection.

Config.Name: Host Root (Disk Metrics)
Config.Description: Read-only mount of host root filesystem for disk space monitoring and low-disk alerts.
